name: SBTweaker
summary: Jailbreak tweak package that customises the iOS Home Screen: dock icons, grid, spacing, icon scale, animations and more.
description: A collection of SpringBoard tweaks in one package with a settings pane, for rootless and roothide jailbreaks on iOS/iPadOS 15+. Controls dock icon count (1-8), home grid rows and columns (1-10), spacing, icon scale, hide App Library, double-tap to lock, icon layout backup, and animation speed options. Every feature is opt-in and applies live where possible.
contains: dock icon count 1-8 with live capacity updates
home screen grid 1-10 rows and columns, portrait and landscape
spacing and icon scale options for home screen and dock
hide App Library, double-tap to lock, lock screen timeout
animation controls: drag coefficient, wake/sleep, unlock fly-in, fast copy, fast transitions
Settings > SBTweaker preference pane; all features opt-in
